messages:
sophie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: several customers hit repeated short-lived surges that exhausted GPU headroom, causing autoscaler thrash. Want owners + concrete next steps.

ron: Summary for context: autoscaler reacts to sustained allocs; short spikes don't trigger scale fast enough and scheduler can't lease small slices quickly -> backlog. Pattern seen on retrain and multitenant eval jobs.

ike: Proposed Action A - Tokenized leasing: change scheduler to offer short leases (30-90s) for queued work to increase turnover. Owner: @ike. ETA: 2026-04-08 (P0). Acceptance: 95th pct queue depth during 60s bursts <= baseline 75th pct.

priya: Action B - Predictive pre-warm: add a predictive pre-warm job that watches trend anomalies and brings minimal headroom online 60s before expected surge. Owner: @priya. ETA: 2026-04-15 (P1). Acceptance: successful pre-warm in 3/3 simulated surge windows on perf cluster.

eng-ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: scheduler-lease-v1 -> shadow on prod-edge for 2h on 2026-03-31T02:00Z (CI#7829).

ron: Action C - Quota backstop rule: automatic soft throttle at routing layer when single tenant reservation > 50% for >45s. Owner: @ron. ETA: 2026-04-02. Acceptance: rate of tenant-induced headroom exhaustion reduces by 60% in tests.

ike: I'll add detailed telemetry for lease-success, lease-fail, lease-latency. Where should metrics live?

sophie: Put them in the headroom namespace and add dashboard tiles. I'll own the dashboard. ETA: 2026-03-29.

priya: Small operational item: add a playbook step for restoring steady-state after autoscaler thrash with rollback steps for scheduler knobs. Owner: @priya. ETA: 2026-03-28.

ron: Also recommend a short-lived "surge relief" mode that can be toggled by ops to enforce stricter fairness. Low blast radius toggle. Owner: @ron. ETA: 2026-04-05.

eng-ops-bot: task-bot: TASK-8120 created "add lease metrics + dashboard" assigned to sophie, due 2026-03-29.

ike: Test plan for leasing: 1) synthetic 2x and 5x bursts, 2) measure how many leases per second allocated, 3) measure tail latency and GPU utilization variance. Will publish run artifacts. ETA: 2026-04-06.

sophie: Dashboard should include: headroom_free_gpus, lease_count, avg_lease_duration, per_tenant_reserved_gpus, prewarm_trigger_rate.

priya: For customer impact: add a step to notify CS if soft throttle engaged for >2m so they can reach out. I'll coordinate with CS.

ike: Quick CLI snippet I'll add to runbook for triage:
```
# headroom short check
redwoodctl metrics query --ns headroom --metric headroom_free_gpus --window 30s
redwoodctl sched leases --cluster prod-edge --last 5m
```

sophie: Can we also add a nightly job to compute weekly surge fingerprints per-customer so we can catch repeat offenders? Owner: @sophie. ETA: 2026-04-10.

ron: I'll draft the acceptance criteria for each task in the remediation tracker and tag severity. ETA: today EOD.

priya: Agree we should run a canary with both leasing and quota backstop enabled in shadow first, then 10% traffic, then full rollout. I'll own the rollout plan. ETA: 2026-04-01 for shadow.

eng-ops-bot: incident-bot: TASK-8121 "surge-relief toggle + runbook" assigned to priya, due 2026-03-28.

ike: Minor note: ensure billing doesn't double-count pre-warm VMs; tagging finance on the tracker.

sophie: ack, will add billing check to quota backstop task.

ron: Let's do a 20-minute sync Friday this week to confirm canary schedule and test harness. Owner: @ron to calendar.

priya: ack :calendar:

ike: ack :white_check_mark:

sophie: ack :thumbsup:

ron: I'll update the remediation tracker now. Please post one-line daily progress until items are in progress.

eng-ops-bot: reminder-bot: Daily reminder set for participants until TASK-8120 is in-progress.
